title: Decision: GCE must precede AppDataUpdate in a Commit
description: mls-extensions-10 §4.7: a GroupContextExtensions proposal 'can be followed by' AppDataUpdates; this reads either as an ordering rule or as a description. OpenMLS refuses AppDataUpdate before GCE (IncorrectOrder). Chosen (Mark): the strict reading, GCE first, matching OpenMLS. wg bead filed.
